verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API at docs.sentry.io/api, but nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. A probe of the usual OpenAPI spec paths returned 404 on every one. A static description of the API is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
